products.name: Heavyweight Farm Broiler (Live Chicken)
products.description: Naturally grown, plump, and healthy broiler chickens raised in open-air conditions. Weighs between 2.5kg and 3.2kg. Ideal for Sunday family stew, celebrations, and bulk culinary needs.

products.name: Whole Dressed & Cleaned Frozen Chicken
products.description: Slaughtered strictly according to hygienic standards, meticulously de-feathered, gutted, cleaned, vacuum sealed, and blast frozen to preserve freshness and nutrients.

specifications.Recommended For: Maize, Yam, Vegetables, Citrus, Fruit Orchards

testimonials.name: Hajiya Fatima Aliyu
testimonials.content: We order broilers and catfish weekly from Ragusma Farms. The chickens are huge, completely healthy, and the free delivery to our restaurant in Tunga is always on time!

testimonials.name: Engr. Daniel Okon
testimonials.content: The dried organic poultry manure from Ragusma Farms doubled our maize and pepper harvest this season. Zero chemical burn and truly organic soil enrichment. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Aisha Mohammed
testimonials.content: Their frozen dressed chicken is so clean, with zero feather residues, nicely packaged, and sweet when cooked. Ordering on the website was quick and seamless.

hero.headline: Fresh From Our Farm, Quality You Can Trust.
hero.subheadline: Discover premium farm-raised live & frozen chicken, healthy rabbits, fresh catfish, and organic manure straight from Ragusma Farms. Rooted in sustainable agricultural heritage.

about.title: Rooted in Passion, Dedicated to Quality
about.paragraph1: At Ragusma Farms, we are pleased to be a family-owned and operated agricultural business dedicated to providing high-quality farm produce and livestock to our community. Our roots run deep in the farming industry with two generations of hands-on experience in livestock, poultry, and crop farming.
about.paragraph2: Founded in 2015 by Hajiya Ramatu Mallam Madaki and co-managed by the Madaki brothers since 2022, Ragusma Farms has evolved into a modern, sustainable farming brand serving households, caterers, hotels, and agricultural partners across Niger State and beyond.
about.quote: Access to Food is a right, not a privilege.
about.founderCaption: Hajiya Ramatu Mallam Madaki (Founder, 2015) & Madaki Brothers (Management)

mission.statement: To promote sustainable agriculture, providing households and commercial clients with healthy, organic, and affordable farm products through responsible farming practices, innovation, environmental stewardship, and dependable delivery.

vision.statement: To become a trusted and leading agricultural brand across Nigeria, recognized for top-tier poultry and livestock, sustainable green economy practices, and unmatched customer satisfaction.

whyChooseUs.title: 100% Healthy & Farm-Raised
whyChooseUs.description: Our poultry, rabbits, and fish are nurtured in hygienic, spacious pastures with organic feeds and regular veterinary oversight.

whyChooseUs.title: Transparent & Affordable Pricing
whyChooseUs.description: Direct farm-gate pricing in Nigerian Naira with zero middleman markups, ensuring healthy food is accessible to every family.

whyChooseUs.title: Free Delivery in Tunga & Pickup
whyChooseUs.description: Enjoy completely free door-to-door delivery within Tunga or collect your order fresh at our farm gate at ₦0 delivery fee.

whyChooseUs.title: Rigorous Hygiene & Processing
whyChooseUs.description: Processed poultry and fish undergo sanitary slaughtering, flash freezing, and insulated temperature-controlled handling.

whyChooseUs.title: Green & Circular Farming
whyChooseUs.description: We recycle animal waste into nutrient-dense organic manure, promoting closed-loop sustainable agriculture and healthier soils.

whyChooseUs.title: Expert Agricultural Advisory
whyChooseUs.description: Consult with seasoned farm managers on poultry setup, fish pond design, rabbitry management, and organic crop fertilization.
